encoder.max_length_reason: intentional frozen CPU latency and index-build resource cutoff; not the upstream model maximum
encoder.query_instruction: Represent this sentence for searching relevant passages:
encoder.token_type_ids: use tokenizer output when present; otherwise an int64 zero array matching input_ids

value_serialization.string: NFKC then collapse Unicode whitespace to one ASCII space and strip
value_serialization.boolean: lowercase JSON literal true or false
value_serialization.sequence: recursively serialize non-omitted elements in source order and join with space-semicolon-space
value_serialization.mapping: normalize keys as strings; sort by (normalized_key.casefold(), normalized_key); recursively serialize values; render non-omitted entries as key space-equals-space value and join with space-semicolon-space
value_serialization.separator_escaping: none; literal separators in source content remain literal after normalization

query.source: Agent._query_terms over current post-override visible state
query.empty_query: return an empty dense route without invoking the tokenizer or model

variants.P7.C00.r08_coverage: served Agent with retrieval=coverage, rerank=off, question_policy=fast
variants.P7.S00.bge_dense_shadow: compute and record dense routes but return response objects exactly equal to C00 and compare their frozen canonical hashes

eligible_turns.non_override: every evaluator response turn whose frozen visible-state query is non-empty
eligible_turns.intent_override: only evaluator response turns turn >= behavior.override.turn, meaning the replacement message has already been delivered; the query must also be non-empty
eligible_turns.empty_query: excluded from recall and latency denominators and records an empty dense route
eligible_turns.early_stop: only turns actually reached by the unchanged C00 evaluator session are eligible

recall_definitions.sparse_turn_pool: stable union of Broad-120 then Strict-80 for the same eligible turn
recall_definitions.dense_union_turn_pool: stable union of sparse_turn_pool then ordered Dense-120 for the same eligible turn
recall_definitions.sparse_session_recalled: target appears in sparse_turn_pool on at least one eligible turn
recall_definitions.dense_session_recalled: target appears in ordered Dense-120 on at least one eligible turn
recall_definitions.dense_union_session_recalled: target appears in dense_union_turn_pool on at least one eligible turn
recall_definitions.rescued_session: sparse_session_recalled is false and dense_session_recalled is true
recall_definitions.strict_improvement: dense-union session recall count is greater than sparse-only session recall count
recall_definitions.scenario_span: number of distinct frozen scenario_type labels among rescued sessions; labels are joined only after all target-blind route captures close

recall_gates.tie_policy: any equality in sparse-only versus dense-union session recall is rejection; numeric resource thresholds are inclusive

resource_measurement.required_asset_bytes: sum file sizes of every model required_files entry, generated float32 embedding matrix, ordered-ASIN file, semantic-index manifest, and bundled third-party license; exclude source catalog, Python packages or wheels, and caches
resource_measurement.cold_initialization_seconds: fresh shadow worker monotonic time immediately before validating/hashing semantic model and index assets through tokenizer construction, CPU ONNX session construction, ordered-ASIN load, and memory-mapped matrix ready; exclude offline catalog embedding construction and sparse Agent construction
resource_measurement.query_search_milliseconds: per eligible turn monotonic time immediately before visible-state query string construction through tokenization, query ONNX inference, CLS/L2 processing, full-matrix dot product, and ordered Dense-120 result; exclude label joins and response generation
resource_measurement.p95_method: sort all eligible-turn durations ascending and select zero-based index ceil(0.95*N)-1
resource_measurement.evaluation_wall_seconds: each variant runs in an independent fresh worker; after its Agent and any semantic shadow are ready, monotonic time immediately around evaluator.evaluate through complete return
resource_measurement.absolute_peak_rss_bytes: operating-system process working set sampled at most every 10 ms from fresh-worker start through evaluation return; compare S00 absolute peak with C00 absolute peak from an independent worker
resource_measurement.network_check: force local/offline environment and record any socket connection attempt as a failure

repeatability.condition: run only if every first-run recall, integrity, and resource gate passes
repeatability.worker: one new process with no reused tokenizer, ONNX session, matrix mapping, or Agent state; set every runtime environment_before_numpy_or_onnxruntime_import value before importing numpy, tokenizers, or onnxruntime

canonical_records.response: one record per reached turn containing 1-based corpus session ordinal, turn, and exact response object; exclude evaluator UUID, durations, process IDs, and timestamps
canonical_records.dense_route: one record per eligible turn containing 1-based corpus session ordinal, turn, normalized query, and ordered entries of parent_asin plus score encoded as float(numpy.float32(score)).hex(); exclude evaluator UUID, labels, targets, durations, process IDs, and timestamps
canonical_records.serialization: UTF-8 canonical JSON Lines with object keys sorted, compact separators, ensure_ascii=false, and LF after every record

decision.all_gates_pass: P7 establishes route feasibility only and permits a newly preregistered P8 hybrid-admission study on a fresh disjoint corpus
decision.recall_or_integrity_fail: reject BGE for P7; do not run released-public evaluation and do not tune P7
decision.recall_pass_resource_fail: reject BGE for P7; MiniLM fallback requires a fresh P8 corpus and new preregistration
